rationale: Residual load after hydro and storage is h1=75, h2=90, h3=85 MW. Each hour lies within coal [40,100] MW, so the cheapest unit (coal, 22 USD/MWh) serves all residual load alone; gas stays offline. Total thermal = 250 MWh -> cost 250*22 = 5500 USD and emissions 250*0.75 = 187.5 t, which is below the 200 t cap.
